streetcar.route_description: Loop between downtown and the Blackstone District: westbound on Farnam St from downtown to the 39th St terminus; eastbound on Harney St from Turner Blvd back to 10th St; downtown loop north on 10th St to Capitol Ave, east on Capitol to 8th St, south on 8th to Farnam. About 3 miles. 16 stops: 13 curb stops on Farnam, Harney, Capitol Ave and 8th St, plus 3 median stops on Farnam between Midtown Crossing and Blackstone.
streetcar.route_line_note: Schematic: straight segments joining the geocoded stop points in running order, not the surveyed track alignment.

opening_date_sources.conflicting_date_on_page: none (only fall 2028; a manager quote says "by 2028, 2029" loosely)

opening_date_sources.says: goal is to begin carrying riders by the third quarter of 2028

opening_date_sources.source: City of Omaha / Omaha Streetcar Authority project page on PublicInput
opening_date_sources.says: Round 2 re-read: 'expected to be operational in 2028'; 'When the streetcar begins operating in 2028'; timeline 'Testing & Commissioning' 2027-2028 and 'In Service' 2028. The 'early 2027' blurb seen in the verify pass is no longer on the page.
opening_date_sources.conflicting_date_on_page: none now (verify pass saw an early-2027 blurb; gone on 16 Nov 2026 round-2 read)

disagreements: Stop count: city/HDR/KLKN say 16 stops; omahaguide.com says 13 stops and Wikipedia's infobox says 13 stations.
Western terminus: city release (Nov 2023) says 39th & Farnam; Grow Omaha says 40th & Farnam; older plans and omahaguide.com say 42nd St.
Opening: older materials said 2026 or spring/early 2027 (Midtown Crossing post, Jan 2024, said stops 'scheduled for operation in 2027'); every 2026 source says 2028.
Turner Blvd median stop: Grow Omaha (Jan 2026) places it 'just east of 31st Avenue'; coordinates here use the 3100 Farnam block.

Opening, official pages (verify pass, 16 Nov 2026): omahastreetcar.org now loads and says 'expected to be operational in early 2027'; its newest dated item is June 2024, so it looks stale. The city's PublicInput page carries both 'expected to be operational in early 2027' (top blurb) and 'When the streetcar begins operating in 2028' plus a timeline with 'In Service 2028'. Every 2026 news source says 2028, so 2028 stands. ROUND 2 UPDATE (16 Nov 2026): PublicInput no longer shows 'early 2027'; it now says 2028 only, with testing and commissioning in 2027-2028. omahastreetcar.org still says 'early 2027' (newest item June 18, 2024).
streetcar.official_site_status: omahastreetcar.org loaded in the verify pass (16 Nov 2026). It confirms 16 stops and 'east on Harney Street and west on Farnam Street', but its opening date ('early 2027') is out of date. The city's PublicInput page and 2026 news are used for the opening date.

route_sources_verify.confirms: 16 stops as listed; 13 curb + 3 median; termini 39th & Farnam (west) and 10th & Capitol (north); no opening date
downtown loop east on Capitol, down 8th to Farnam, then west on Farnam (older version ran 10th to Cass)
cars return via Harney, 10th, Capitol Ave, 8th and Farnam
16 stops; east on Harney, west on Farnam; says 'early 2027' (stale)

streetcar.opening_sources_order_note: Ordered so the first source states 2028 with no other opening date on the same page: WOWT (fall 2028), then KMTV (Q3 2028), then the city's PublicInput page (2028; testing 2027-2028).
